_howto: Paste Instagram or LinkedIn posts here and the site turns each one into a short news story, crediting the post as its source. Each entry needs `url` (the post link) and `account` (who posted it). Add `text` with the post's caption: LinkedIn usually hides posts from servers, so the site can only read the preview on its own when the post is public. Optional: `date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `title` to set the headline yourself, and `category` (admissions, achievements, placements, research, campus, events). Commit the file and Vercel republishes the site.

_example.text: Paste the post's caption here. The site rewrites it as a news item and links back to the post.
